name: Infisical
label: Infisical Public REST API
description: Infisical Public REST API (secrets v4, folders v2) via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://infisical.com/docs/api-reference/overview/introduction. Operations: get-secret, list-secrets, create-secret, update-secret, delete-secret, list-folders, listen. delete-secret sends official JSON body (projectId, environment, optional secretPath/type) — https://infisical.com/docs/api-reference/endpoints/secrets/delete. Auth secret access_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). GET/access operations still call the official GET (or access) HTTP method. Retrieved secret material must not be logged and should stay in StudioQuack secret bindings (bind OUTPUT `data` into a secret; do not print it, persist it in engine variables, or leave it on a logged edge). Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put access_token here. Path params match api_spec.json placeholders. Example: {"operation":"get-secret"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: get-secret | list-secrets | create-secret | update-secret | delete-secret | list-folders | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: 'get-secret'.

schema.label: secretName
schema.description: Secret name path segment for get/create/update/delete.

schema.label: secretValue
schema.description: create/update value from a StudioQuack secret binding. Never a logged field.

schema.label: path
schema.description: Folder path for list-folders (query path). secretPath is used for secret ops.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Query-string/request-body parameter `type` for operations: get-secret, create-secret, update-secret, delete-secret.

schema.label: viewSecretValue
schema.description: Query-string parameter `viewSecretValue` for operations: get-secret, list-secrets.

schema.label: recursive
schema.description: Query-string parameter `recursive` for operations: list-secrets, list-folders.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Secret bytes in data must not be logged; bind them into StudioQuack secrets. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON from the official API. May contain secret material — never log; bind into StudioQuack secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: get-secret, list-secrets, create-secret, update-secret, delete-secret, list-folders, listen. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Universal Auth access token (or equivalent identity token). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never logged. OfficialApiNode does not exchange client id/secret.

configurationParameters.label: Site host
configurationParameters.description: API host without scheme. Cloud default app.infisical.com. Self-host: your Infisical host.

configurationParameters.label: Folder path
configurationParameters.description: list-folders query path. Default /. Distinct from secretPath used on secret ops.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon invoke budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
